comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is a food truck ordering system?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or when they collect, and the order appears in your kitchen. A POS (till) or card machine takes payment at the truck. The two complement each other.
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also include Stripe’s fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.termQ: Is there a minimum contract period?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is neither a minimum contract period nor a notice period. You can cancel any time; the fee is paid monthly in advance, and you can use the service until the end of the month you paid for.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work at changing places?
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times; customers order for the place and day you are there.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system stop my kitchen being overloaded beyond capacity?
comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see the collection times your kitchen can actually make. The system works from each dish’s prep time and how many you make in one batch.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till with a TSE?
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till (POS) and has no TSE. Ask your tax adviser how to record online orders in your till.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported for now.
